svg.title: Measured c(t) and d(t) for Pythia 70M
svg.desc: Four columns show residual layers 1, 3, 5 and logits. The first row plots cumulative arc length c(t), the second relative endpoint distance d(t), on matching zero-to-one axes. Every point comes from an actual 41-sample SLERP run.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: A real run, two views of the same trajectory
Pythia 70M · after layer 0 · SLERP · 41 samples · final-token measurement
A “The house was big” B “The house was in”
Same samples. Separate normalization for every readout. Raw total path length appears under c(t).
Measured example, not a general plateau claim. Source values and model revision are included in measured-example.json.
